about.heading: A space built *for balance*
paragraphs: KLUB stands for Keep Living Under Balance. Warm plaster walls, arched doorways, soft light and calm proportions — a studio designed to slow you down the moment you walk in.
On the floor it's serious equipment and small groups: reformer classes capped at six, so your instructor sees every rep — your alignment, your pace, your progress.
